title: Mushroom Goddess Ritual
description: A surreal black and white illustration features a giant mushroom with the serene face of a woman with closed eyes and long flowing hair forming its cap. Below, a dark ritual scene unfolds with two horned figures holding torches beside a glowing fire, surrounded by lily pads, smaller mushrooms, twisted trees, and floating bubbles.
prompt: Surreal black and white fantasy scene of a giant mushroom with a woman's peaceful face and closed eyes on its cap, long flowing hair merging with the gills and patterns. At the base, two small horned shadowy figures with torches stand beside a bright fire on dark soil. The foreground contains lily pads on dark water, various mushrooms, twisted gnarled trees with hanging moss, and floating transparent bubbles in the air.
